column1: # Source: https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/bls.ics ("BLS.gov Economic News Release Schedule"), fetched 2026-09-21.
# The feed's VEVENTs for the two releases the event filter sleeps for, 2025-01 -> 2026-12; the BLS site refuses scripted
# downloads, so the feed was read in a browser and its varying fields kept here. Every block in the feed has the same
# shape (SEQUENCE:1, CLASS:PUBLIC, DURATION:PT0M, LOCATION:Washington\, DC, TRANSP:TRANSPARENT, CATEGORIES:IMPORTANT, BLS)
# and the build script emits it back in that shape. Columns: UID, DTSTART (TZID=US-Eastern), SUMMARY.
